headline: Romania's stepped personal deduction makes one more leu of pay cost take-home pay at 40 points between 4.050 and 6.050 lei a month, with a cliff of up to 161 lei a month at 6.051 for parents and under-26s; owner-managers keep ~80 % of profit through a micro-enterprise, but a PFA keeps more above ~760.000 lei (2025) and ~300.000 lei (2026 dividend rate).
